sentences.text: (4) Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that he has not committed any offence and has been falsely implicated in the crime.
The entry of date of birth in the scholar register was not proved.

It is further submitted that the prosecutrix remained in the company of the appellant for one month in different places and during this period she did not raise any alarm or made any complaint to anybody and DNA was not taken, FSL report is negative.
The age of the prosecutrix is above 20 years.
The learned trial Court has wrongly relied on the scholar register in assessing the age of the prosecutrix.
Final hearing of the appeal will take sufficient long time in near future.
Hence, prays for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
(5) Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

(6) Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, evidence of Rajesh Kumar (PW-7),
Principal of Veena Vidha Niketan, Mandsaur, coupled with the fact that final hearing of the appeal will take long time in near future, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the opinion that the jail sentence of appellant is liable to be suspended.

(7) Accordingly, I.A.No.4472/2023 is allowed and it is directed subject to deposit of fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned trial Court,
the execution of remaining custodial part of the sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended,
till final disposal of this appeal.
(8) The appellant after being enlarged on bail shall mark his presence before the trial Court on 22/12/2023 and thereafter on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed in this behalf.
Accordingly I.A.No.4472/2023 stands allowed and disposed off.
Certified copy as per rules.
(S. A. DHARMADHIKARI)

JUDGE   RJ Salman @ Sallu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171500807/
